spec_items.title: Fusion-core slice: schema + provenance/calibration enforcement + variant_effect ingest & read view
spec_items.aim: Substrate precondition for all aims (build plan Phase 1)

spec_items.title: variant_effect producer: multi-tool consensus VUS reclassification with per-population calibration flags
spec_items.aim: Aim 1 assist (build plan Phase 2 — first shippable win)

spec_items.title: Ingestion adapters from existing pipeline outputs (sarek MAFs, DESeq2 tables, IntOGen, MSISensor2, ADMIXTURE/RFMix, drug-screen readouts)
Reference reconciliation: key variants by (locus, ref-context); reconcile GRCh38 vs. pangenome callsets; flag pangenome-only-in-African-ancestry candidates
Wire real score providers (AlphaMissense + EVE pre-computed scores; retain PolyPhen/SIFT) behind the existing provider interface
DeepSomatic added at the calling step, run in parallel with Mutect2; callset comparison to quantify reference/caller bias
Target nomination: elastic-net + random-forest ensemble; DGIdb (druggability), MatrixEQTL (eQTL), Cox (survival) as edges on target nodes
spec_items.readiness: UNKNOWN (build plan §6: "once the substrate is FUNCTIONAL" — substrate = Phase 1, whose SPEC-003/004 are still SPECIFIED; whether the precondition is met is ambiguous)

spec_items.title: GNN over the PPI graph (STRING/BioGRID tagged with study mutation + expression data) — NOVEL, strongest controls (G6)
Query layer: grounded text-to-SQL with schema validation + literature retrieval; interface views (cohort explorer, evidence-chain viewer, target dashboard)
Drug-response pre-screen (GDSC/CCLE/DepMap-trained) as triage that only adds, never subtracts
spec_items.readiness: GATED — organoid specimens / drug-screen data do not exist yet (build plan §6: "Phase 5 cannot start until organoid specimens/drug-screen data exist")

spec_items.title: Organoid imaging: CellPose segmentation + CNN morphological features
spec_items.readiness: GATED — same wet-lab data gate (build plan §6)

spec_items.title: Causal layer: Double ML / causal forests, validated against CRISPR knock-in/reversion isogenics — NOVEL, strongest controls (G6)
spec_items.readiness: GATED — same wet-lab data gate (build plan §6)

spec_items.title: Custom multi-modal variant predictor (decision D5: commit only if Phase 2 leaves meaningful residual VUS) — NOVEL, strongest controls (G6)
spec_items.aim: Aim 2b (Phase 5 — gated on D5 + wet-lab data)
spec_items.readiness: GATED — decision D5 (OPEN, after Phase 2 data) + wet-lab data (build plan §6)

spec_items.title: Agent-control CI enforcement: test gates on push/PR + mechanical SPEC-id check on every PR
spec_items.aim: Cross-cutting — the control protocol itself (docs/risk-and-agent-control.md Part 3)

spec_items.title: Query layer: deterministic structured read API over core read views (no NL) — filters, per-population VUS summary, query/provenance echo, result-level calibration caveat, named refusals for undefined criteria
spec_items.aim: The distillation deliverable (Phase 4 precursor — the deterministic layer SPEC-009's NL front-end must translate INTO, never around; docs/risk-and-agent-control.md S5)

spec_items.title: Repo hygiene: disjoint fixture ID namespaces across fixture directories + run/documentation honesty (docs claim only what was executed)
Status truthfulness: docs never assert undecided decisions; Readiness axis; human-owned data inventory; generated STATUS + CI drift gate
Local dev dashboard: static status.json renderer (architecture + SPEC/phase views, blockers) + read-only localhost shim over the query API
spec_items.aim: Cross-cutting — developer ergonomics only; NOT the researcher UI (R7 — interface/ stays empty and reserved)

spec_items.title: Collaborator-map correctness: STATUS §6 producer slots derive from the single source (ARCHITECTURE.md §5 via producer_slots[]) and carry their Readiness — no hand-maintained lists

drivers producer: IntOGen driver identification on the reclassified variant table — i.e. RUNNING the IntOGen pipeline (dNdScv, cBaSE, OncodriveCLUSTL, smRegions, HotMAPS, OncodriveFML, MutPanning) over this project's own cohort mutations
spec_items.aim: Aim 1 (build plan Phase 2 — "reclassified variant table feeds the IntOGen driver-identification step")
spec_items.readiness: GATED — requires cohort mutation data, which does not exist (docs/DATA-INVENTORY.md: 7 of 8 study datasets UNKNOWN in every field); and IntOGen-plus is a Nextflow/container pipeline, i.e. `pipeline/` work, not a Python producer. Readiness corrected from AVAILABLE — decision D-011

spec_items.title: expression producer: DESeq2 / GSEA / DoRothEA transcriptomic path (R/Bioconductor). KNOWN PREREQUISITE GAP: the repo has no R tooling, no renv.lock, and Python-only CI — flagged, not solved
spec_items.readiness: UNKNOWN (same build plan §6 "once the substrate is FUNCTIONAL" precondition as SPEC-007/008, plus the R-tooling gap)

spec_items.title: Close loose ends: register orphan producer slots (I6) + finish the D4 demotion sweep in core/db.py and core/README.md
Drift-gate determinism: STATUS artifacts byte-identical across platforms (LF-pinned via .gitattributes) so local git-status noise cannot mask real drift
spec_items.aim: Cross-cutting — a gate that cries wolf gets ignored (G3 discipline)

spec_items.title: Dashboard information hierarchy: Section 1 dominates, boilerplate deduplicated, file:line evidence in not_built, reference sections collapsed, print stylesheet
spec_items.aim: Cross-cutting — developer ergonomics (R7: still not the researcher UI)

spec_items.title: Core data integrity: per-population variant identity (population is a property of the observation, D-004) + idempotent ingest via schema-enforced natural key (D-005)
spec_items.aim: Substrate precondition for all aims — per-population fidelity is the project's premise

spec_items.title: drivers producer (reference signal): POSITIONAL driver evidence from IntOGen's published compendium — join by gene, intersect the variant's residue with the published significant domains / 2D clusters / 3D clusters, emit evidence with cohort provenance. A distinct capability from SPEC-020, which RUNS the pipeline; this one LOOKS UP results computed on other cohorts. Reports evidence, never a driver call on a variant
spec_items.aim: Aim 1 — a driver axis distinct from the pathogenicity axis (D-008); decision D-011

spec_items.title: Multi-producer core: a producer-neutral `producer_result` table + `v_producer_result` / `v_variant` read views, so a second producer has somewhere to write and something producer-neutral to read
spec_items.aim: Substrate precondition for every producer after variant_effect (drivers, expression, target_nomination, gnn, causal, imaging, multimodal_predictor) — decision D-012

spec_items.title: Identifier-mapping seam: `variant_id` → external identifiers (UniProt accession, transcript, locus) as its own contract, so a producer LOOKS UP identifiers and never derives them; unblocks real score providers without waiting on SPEC-004
spec_items.aim: Aim 1 — decision D-006 option (c); precondition for SPEC-005's real score providers
